The '''Mussubir system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mussubir Three]].
